missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative predicate. 'Знакомый' is a substantivized adjective in the nominative, naming the person. 'Мой' and 'старый' agree in masculine nominative. Useful for introductions.
Strategic focus: Accusative animate object. 'Знакомого' is animate masculine, so its accusative copies the genitive form. 'Встретил' takes the direct object, and 'старого' agrees the same way.
Strategic focus: Genitive of possession. 'Знакомого' is genitive after 'у' to mark whose car it is. 'Моего' agrees in masculine genitive, and 'большая машина' is the nominative subject.
Strategic focus: Dative after a verb. 'Знакомому' is the dative object of 'позвонил', the person called. 'Своему' agrees in masculine dative. A standard phone-call pattern.
Strategic focus: Instrumental of accompaniment. 'Знакомым' is instrumental after 'со' to express coming together with someone. 'Вместе' reinforces the togetherness.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'О знакомом' uses the prepositional form after 'о' to mark the topic. 'Нашем' agrees in masculine prepositional, naming the person discussed.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural subject. 'Знакомые' is the nominative plural acting as the subject. 'Мои' agrees, 'живут' is the plural verb, and 'в городе' gives the location.
Strategic focus: Accusative animate plural. 'Знакомых' is animate plural, so its accusative copies the genitive. 'Всех' and 'своих' agree in the same animate form. Useful for invitations.

missions.phrase: У меня много знакомых в Москве.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Genitive plural after a quantifier. 'Знакомых' is genitive plural because 'много' governs that case. 'В Москве' adds the place where they live.
Strategic focus: Accusative animate object. 'Знакомого' is animate masculine, so the accusative copies the genitive form. 'Этого' agrees, and 'давно' marks the long acquaintance.
